# The Board Game Café

Official website: https://theboardgamecafe.co.uk/
Location: Unit 12, The Stables, Eanam, Blackburn BB1 5BY, United Kingdom
Phone: +44 7768 489048
Bookings: bookings@theboardgamecafe.co.uk
Events and private hire: events@theboardgamecafe.co.uk

The Board Game Café is a social gaming café and lounge in Blackburn offering board games, console gaming, selected live sport, movie-night options, desserts, karak chai, drinks, table reservations, group bookings, birthday parties and private venue hire.
